description: Create a mutual-stake escrow vault between the Agent Wallet (buyer) and a counterparty (seller). Both parties lock collateral (equal to payment amount) ensuring aligned incentives. Uses USDC as the payment token. Requires FACTORY_ADDRESS env var or factoryAddress param.

factoryAddress.description: StakeVaultFactory address (optional if FACTORY_ADDRESS env var set)

stakeAmount.description: Payment amount in human-readable USDC units (e.g. "100")

terms.description: Human-readable description of the escrow terms

name: create_escrow
